narrative.overview: The Crack Inspection Platform is a mission-critical civil engineering telemetry and forensic audit console. It operates as a focused, dark-mode cockpit for structural engineers and field inspectors evaluating concrete integrity across bridges, high-rise building pillars, and dams. The visual atmosphere is calm, precise, and authoritative—eliminating visual noise while presenting high-resolution spatial crack maps, AI confidence values, and structural risk indicators with zero ambiguity.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-Distraction Telemetry: Deep obsidian surfaces with frosted glass layers keeping spatial crack maps and quantitative metrics central.
Calibrated Safety Spectrum: Uncompromising color grammar mapping directly to structural danger levels.
Tactile Decisiveness: Rounded 12px–24px containers with micro-scale interactive states, crisp luminous borders, and responsive feedback.
Engineering Authenticity: Font choices, monospace coordinate badges, and ReportLab-aligned tabular data.

rules.name: The Rarity of Red Rule
rules.body: The Alarm Rose hue is strictly reserved for confirmed structural cracks and emergency hazard states. It must never appear on generic action buttons or secondary UI decorations.

rules.name: The Glass Depth Rule
rules.body: Floating cards must always maintain subtle border illumination (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) with backdrop blur (10px–12px) against the obsidian canvas, avoiding opaque flat gray blocks.

rules.name: The Monospace Telemetry Rule
rules.body: All grid cell identifiers (P1–P36), coordinates ([row, col]), percentages, and audit IDs must render in monospace font to emphasize scientific precision.

rules.name: The Tonal Lift Rule
rules.body: Hovering over interactive cards or inspection rows translates elements upwards by 1px–2px with a subtle background light lift, avoiding artificial dark shadows.

dos: Do format all AI petak IDs, rows, columns, and percentages with monospace font.
Do maintain the 6x6 matrix spatial proportions (square aspect ratio) during image slicing.
Do reserve high-saturation red exclusively for active cracks and critical degradation alerts.
Do display both the raw cell count alongside the calculated percentage.
Do keep cards and navigation frosted (backdrop-filter: blur) against the obsidian canvas.
donts: Don't use generic bright primary colors outside the established civil engineering safety spectrum.
Don't use opaque flat gray cards that kill the glassmorphism depth.
Don't hide quantitative metrics behind unnecessary clicks—keep critical indicators immediately visible.
Don't display crack detections without corresponding AI confidence percentages.
